thermal_expansion.note: thermal growth with the same supports as the gas case (split plane fixed, cut faces symmetric); includes bending of the bank, so out-of-round is an upper bound

boundary_conditions: 100 mm slice centred on cylinder 3 (contains its complete bore wall ring); crank-axis split plane fixed; the two cut faces (x = cyl. 3 +/- 50 mm) are symmetry planes (axial displacement fixed); design pressure on the upper 50 mm of the bore of cylinder 3 only; no head clamp load, no bolt preload. A first 73 mm slice (narrower than the bore) had no complete hoop ring and gave a meaningless 95 mm deflection - rejected
